The `ghostty/` directory holds Nubb's bundled themes, copied from
https://github.com/mbadolato/iTerm2-Color-Schemes/tree/master/ghostty.

This is MIT licensed, see `LICENSE` in this directory.

Only dark themes with a neutral background (black or gray, no visible
tint) are kept. A background counts as tinted at OKLCH chroma 0.008 or
more. Any other theme from that folder still works if you copy it into
`~/.config/nubb/themes/`.

Source: release `release-20261012-151317-d3e95e4` (the tarball Ghostty
pinned at the fork point).
